# Credits and asset provenance

## Base weapon models — original work

The 29 base weapons and the four knife bodies in `public/assets/weapons/` are
**clean-room recreations generated by this project** from the reference art in
the repository root. `tools/blender/` builds them from numeric descriptions:
reference PNGs are used only to calibrate silhouette, proportion and colour
zones, and no reference pixel is ever projected onto exported geometry.

No Valve, Source 2 or other third-party game asset is downloaded, extracted or
imported for these models.

## Third-party finish models — CC-BY-4.0

Three weapon finishes were supplied by the project owner and are **not** original
work of this project. They were converted to this game's rig contract by
`tools/blender/convert_user_model.py` (scale normalised to real-world length,
muzzle oriented to the game's forward axis, origin moved to the grip, and the
`Muzzle` / `ViewmodelAnchor` / hand-IK anchors added). Their geometry and
textures are unchanged.

| Weapon | Finish | Author | Licence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AK-47 | Wild Lotus (`wildlotus`) | WoodenManufacturing | CC-BY-4.0 | <https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/csgo-ak47-wild-lotus-0af74d693a014c4d9fe5538b99dc0355> |
| AWP | Gungnir (`gungnir`) | WoodenManufacturing | CC-BY-4.0 | <https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/csgo-weapon-awp-gungnir-e1d6a40dc1f1499c8b960b05d13e7f6c> |
| Butterfly Knife | CS Styled (`butterfly-csstlyed`) | Aslady | CC-BY-4.0 | <https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/csgo-styled-butterfly-knife-6f023e5fb12947e18ce2d93d38e13cfd> |

Each model's Sketchfab page declares `http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/`.
Attribution is required by that licence and is reproduced in-game in the armory
finish picker, and in `src/weapons/WeaponSkins.ts`, which is the single source of
truth for these entries.

### Note on trade marks

The finish names "Wild Lotus" and "Gungnir" are skin designs associated with
Counter-Strike. The CC-BY-4.0 licence above is granted by the Sketchfab authors
for their own modelling work and does not grant any rights to Valve's designs or
trade marks. These finishes are included here at the project owner's request for
personal use; they are not original work of this project and are kept separate
from the base models so they can be removed without affecting the rest of the
weapon library. Their manifest status is `third_party`.

## Reference images

The PNG/JPG files in the repository root are the project's own modelling
references. They are used for measurement only and are served to the armory as
reference art, never as textures on exported geometry.

## Third-party software

- [Blender](https://www.blender.org/) — offline asset authoring.
- [three.js](https://threejs.org/) — runtime rendering, MIT.
- [Vite](https://vite.dev/), [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/), [Playwright](https://playwright.dev/) — build and test tooling.
- Draco mesh compression — the weapon GLBs are Draco-compressed; the decoder is served from three.js's own package at `/draco/`.
